hypothesis: Distribution and incentive alignment rather than technology is the primary barrier to displacing Ren
test: Win/loss interviews with 10 sponsors that evaluated vendors (22 V-1)
falsified_if: Majority of evaluators cite product capability, not incentives or channel, as decisive

hypothesis: Sponsors re-platforming for integration (community and faith foundations) choose integrated fund-accounting suites over DAF-only platforms
test: Analyse destination product scope for all 2023-2026 switches; interview 5 switchers
falsified_if: A switcher chose a DAF-only platform over an integrated suite

hypothesis: Published verifiable migration outcomes (history depth freeze length reconciliation) change vendor selection
test: Offer outcome-backed proposals in 10 evaluations and record selection reasons
falsified_if: Selection reasons never mention migration commitments

hypothesis: A pre-contract migration assessment shortens qualification and raises proposal-to-signature conversion
test: Instrument assessment tier to signature for 10+ opportunities against non-assessed ones

hypothesis: Sponsors will replace a 180-day full re-review policy (a policy choice, not law) with change-driven monitoring plus evidence expiry, and their auditors will accept it
test: Public-data replay plus auditor walkthrough of the evidence model
falsified_if: Auditor or counsel requires full periodic re-review

hypothesis: Eligibility-relevant change rate is about 4% of charities a year and exceptions take about 45 minutes
test: 12-month replay of archived IRS releases plus OFAC/CSL history against real Schedule I recipients
falsified_if: Change rate above 8% or exception minutes above 60

hypothesis: A provenance-bound charity eligibility evidence API has buyers beyond DAF sponsors (CSR platforms administrators payment networks)
test: Price-test with 10 prospective buyers against a $2,750-10k ceiling (Candid Charity Check)
falsified_if: Fewer than 3 of 10 pay above Candid list price

hypothesis: AI assistance reduces handling time per touch by ~40% on DAF exceptions
test: Time study on 200 real exceptions with and without AI preparation

hypothesis: Prevention (structured intents validated recommendations verified destinations) removes more cost than faster processing
test: Shadow replay of a design partner's 12 months comparing exception counts before and after input redesign

hypothesis: A channel partner (distributor or re-platforming administrator) will license and resell an AI-native DAF platform
falsified_if: No candidate accepts a pilot term sheet

hypothesis: Sponsors on vendor-forced migration paths (NPact FIMS legacy; iPhi community foundations) are reachable at contract-end windows
test: Build contract-end calendar for 50 sponsors from public notices and 990s
falsified_if: Fewer than 10 identifiable windows in 24 months

hypothesis: Migration adapter reuse makes the second migration from the same incumbent at least 40% cheaper than the first
test: Measure engineering hours on first and second migrations from one source

hypothesis: Incumbents can replicate published exit terms and migration commitments within 6-12 months if buyers reward them
test: Monitor incumbent terms after first public commitments
falsified_if: No incumbent change within 24 months while Unbound wins on it

hypothesis: Technology-only licensing can reach 30k accounts within 36 months
falsified_if: Fewer than 2 LOIs after 12 months of selling

hypothesis: The temporal charity evidence archive becomes more valuable to each additional sponsor at near-zero marginal cost
test: Track per-sponsor exception reduction as the archive and shared public evidence grow
falsified_if: No measurable reduction in first-time verification exceptions after sponsor 3
